meaning: Heater error: the heater that heats the dishwasher's water is not heating it, or the water overheated above 90°C (194°F).
causes: Heater malfunction: the water supplied to the dishwasher is not being heated
diySteps: Try one reset: press Power to turn the dishwasher off
Switch off the dishwasher's circuit breaker for 10 seconds
Restore power and try to run another cycle
If HE appears again, request LG service
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: LG says HE requires inspection by a service technician if it returns after a reset. A related code, tE, points to the temperature sensor and also needs a technician.
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
